{{Quote|As the Trade Federation signs this treaty of peace with the Empire, we recognize that our constituent parts are no longer under our control. We ask only that the Emperor grant us special dispensation during the distribution of assets in light of our proven track record in business.|Sentepeth Findos|<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>}}
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], a historic '''treaty''' was signed between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] in the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|aftermath]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[Koto-Si/Legends|Koto-Si]], [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia's]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. The acting [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Sentepeth Findos]] was forced to sign it at gunpoint.

The Galactic Empire then began to [[Imperialization/Legends|liquidate]] the Trade Federation, while it legal existence continued under the supervision of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].

Despite this, however, one of the Trade Federation officials, [[Customs Vizier]] [[Marath Vooro]], disagreed with the viceroy and [[Trade Federation resistance|fought]] the Empire until he was [[Battle of the Hook Nebula|captured at]] [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]].

==Terms==
The treaty stipulated resources of the Trade Federation were placed under the Galactic Empire disposal. The Trade Federation was to transfer over it constituent parts to Imperial control as part of the process of [[Imperialization/Legends|imperialization]] and be placed under the oversight of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]].

The Trade Federation would however be permitted special dispensation during the distribution of assets to the Empire in light of the Federation proven track record in business as the wind-down of its affairs began during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]].
